texts.zh:
科学枢纽的理事会激动地发表声明，宣称他们将提供一次难得的机会以招募广受赞誉的科学家艾克斯哈索尔博士，这是一个在寿命延长领域享誉已久的名字。

他和他的团队研发的一种证实有良好寿命延长能力的血清已经到了研究的最终阶段，但此时他们已经花光了科研经费。然而招募艾克斯哈索尔博士意味着我们没有足够的资源以继续我们现行的，一项由葛洛亦克博士领导的有关有机工程的研究。她现在正试图把工程学研究与一台有机超级计算机串流。
texts.en:
The board of the Science Nexus are thrilled to announce that they have been given a unique opportunity to recruit widely acclaimed researcher Dr. Xhaxxore, a prominent name within the field of life-extension.

He and his staff were in the final stages of developing a serum that has shown good promise of prolonging life, when they ran out of funds. Hiring Dr. Xhaxxore however, means we will not have the resources to continue our current research into organic engineering, led by Dr. Groik. She is attempting to streamline engineering research with the use of an organic supercomputer.

label.zh: 用1000点能量币招募艾克斯哈索尔博士。
优先进行葛洛亦克博士的研究。
我们没钱招募艾克斯哈索尔博士。
label.en: We can't afford to hire Dr. Xhaxxore.

texts.zh:
艾克斯哈索尔博士和他的团队本周早些时候发表了他们的研究结果。据信，他们从[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上发现的香精中提取出了一种血清，当它被涂抹在皮肤上时，会引发史无前例细胞再生。

可惜的是现在有几个人就艾克斯哈索尔收到资金一事表示抱怨。葛洛亦克博士现在甚至指责艾克斯哈索尔是个骗子。现在她提出请求和500能量币的预算，以发起秘密调查。如果艾克斯哈索尔察觉他可能会反感并离开。
texts.en:
Dr. Xhaxxore and his team demonstrated the results from their research earlier this week. The serum, when applied to the skin, causes unprecedented cell regeneration, supposedly thanks to the miracle ingredient, "essence of [missing_pops_planet.GetName]", named after its mysterious origin.

Sadly, there have been complaints from a few individuals regarding the additional funding Xhaxxore received. Dr. Groik has even gone so far as to accuse Xhaxxore of being a fraud. Now she requests permission, as well as an additional budget of 500 credits, to launch a secret investigation. If Xhaxxore finds out he might take offense and leave.

label.zh: 并没有什么能支持她的说法。
label.en: There's nothing to back her claims.

label.zh: 开始调查，凡事以安全为主。
label.en: Investigate, to be on the safe side.

texts.zh:
艾克斯哈索尔带着所有研究成果走了，只留下了他那惊慌失措的团队。他们也对他的突然离去表示不解，也就是说，所有宣称了解博士品格，说博士是一个富有魅力，慷慨，愿意为他的团队做一切的天才的人，现在能提供的博士传奇成就的证据都不过是传闻而已。

我们只能承认葛洛亦克博士说他是骗子是对的，或者他拿着他神秘的精华去找出价更高的人去了。如果他再在哪用这个伎俩的话，我们会找到他的。
texts.en:
Xhaxxore is gone and he's taken all his research with him, leaving only his bewildered staff behind. They were as blindsided by his sudden disappearance as we were, and though all attest to the content of his character, painting a portrait of a charismatic and charitable genius who would do anything for his team, they could only offer anecdotal evidence of his achievements.

We can only speculate as to whether Dr. Groik was right to call him a fraud, or whether he took his miracle essence to a higher bidder. If he ever tries a similar scheme elsewhere, we will find him.

texts.zh:
葛洛亦克博士对艾克斯哈索尔的研究的调查获得了有趣的结果。艾克斯哈索尔博士不仅极大夸大了血清的效果，还隐瞒了血清疗效只是暂时的这一事实。而且如果过度使用血清，副作用将是永久的。

精华本身也被查明，是提取自[ointment_name.GetName]星系的一个原生物种的腺体，经调查该生物正是[target_country.GetName]的[target_country.GetSpeciesName]。艾克斯哈索尔甚至在低温室囚禁了数个[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]以保证精华的供应。很明显如果他们要是发现了真相的话我们和他们帝国的外交关系将遭受极大损失。
texts.en:
Dr. Groik's investigation into Xhaxxore's research has yielded some interesting results. Not only has Dr. Xhaxxore greatly exaggerated the effects of the serum, he has neglected to mention that they are only temporary. The side-effects, however, when over-used, can be quite permanent.

The essence itself has been extracted from a gland found in a species native to the [ointment_name.GetName] system, none other than the [target_country.GetSpeciesName] of the [target_country.GetName]. Xhaxxore has held several [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in cryostasis for months to secure the necessary supply of essence. It is likely that our diplomatic ties with their empire would suffer if they were to discover the truth.

label.zh: 终止项目并逮捕艾克斯哈索尔。此事绝不能让旁人知晓。
label.en: Terminate the project and apprehend Xhaxxore. No one can know.

label.zh: 让葛洛亦克闭嘴，把产品推销成延寿膏。
label.en: Silence Groik and market the product as anti-aging cream.

tooltips.zh: 伴随着强大的推销策略，这种产品短期内将收获巨大利润。
tooltips.en: With an intense marketing campaign the product may yield a hefty profit in the near future.

texts.zh:
可惜的是狡诈的艾克斯哈索尔博士溜过了我们的追捕，把他的团队和实验对象弃之不理。[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已被唤醒，幸运的是他们并没有回想起遭遇的一切。至于艾克斯哈索尔，他可能正逃往一个遥远的星系，用着不同的名字，计谋着下一场骗局。只要运气不坏，在他下一次失手时我们会抓住他的。

而他那不光彩的团队似乎是被他的个人魅力所迷惑了，就像我们那样。我们能提供给他们一次加入科学枢纽的机会以弥补他们的过错。
texts.en:
Regrettably the mysterious Dr. Xhaxxore has slipped through our clutches, leaving his staff and test-subjects behind. The [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been awoken and thankfully have no recollection of what they've been through. As for Xhaxxore he is probably already on his way to some distant system, under a different name, plotting his next con. With a little luck, the next time he slips up we will be there to catch him.

His disgraced staff seem to have been as blindsided as we were by his charm, and many have offered to join the Science Nexus permanently to make up for their mistakes.

label.en: They are welcome to join us.

label.zh: 他们显然不是星系间最耀眼的明星……
label.en: They're clearly not the brightest stars in the galaxy...

texts.zh:
以“寿无限”之名将产品推销上市后，[ointment_name.GetName]精华在星系间引起轩然大波。多亏发明人的个人魅力和可靠的推销策略，这种新型的神奇有机膏被广泛赞誉。每个星系的个体物种的明星们都“寿无限，无限延寿”了起来。

博士是怎么取得这么多[target_country.GetSpeciesAdj]腺体以让血清进行大规模生产的，至今还是个谜。
texts.en:
Marketed under the name "Ageless," the Essence of [ointment_name.GetName] has taken the galaxy by storm. Thanks to its charismatic inventor and a solid marketing campaign, the new "organic" miracle cream is being promoted everywhere. Stars, of the personal kind, in every system are "aging less with Ageless."

How the doctor has managed to procure enough [target_country.GetSpeciesAdj] glands to mass-produce the serum, however, remains a mystery...

texts.zh:
由于最近的失踪事件，[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上的动乱愈发严重。在过去的两月间，有数千名以上的居民失踪，其中绝大多数都是被孤立分化的偏远地区群体。这也解释了为什么这件事发生已然很长时间，但我们现在才注意到它。

当地执法部门已经要求更多的资源以进行进一步调查以及对骚乱的弹压。
texts.en:
Unrest is rising on [missing_pops_planet.GetName] in light of a recent wave of planetwide disappearances. Several thousand denizens have been reported missing in the last two months alone and the vast majority are from marginalized and isolated groups in remote areas. This could explain why it has taken so long to come to our attention.

Local law enforcement has requested additional resources to handle the growing unrest while they continue their investigation.

label.zh: 他们的失踪一定有什么原因……
label.en: Surely they were marginalized for a reason...

texts.zh: [missing_pops_planet.GetName]的执法部门为了顺利地调查最近的一起神秘的人口失踪事件，需要军队的配合来平息骚乱。
texts.en: Local law-enforcement on [missing_pops_planet.GetName] need the support of a military strike force to stifle unrest as they investigate a recent wave of mysterious disappearances.

texts.zh:
关于发生在[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上的失踪事件，我们找到了些线索。他们所有人都在即将开业的太空赌场——天空之城中得到一个工作机会。那里的工作人员都穿着奇诡，说着莫名的外星语言。进一步的调查显示，如果这个赌场真的存在，那么它不位于这个星系的任何已知区域内。

专门打击力量的存在似乎使绑匪不敢进行下一次行动，我们已减弱了警力来引蛇出洞，以便当地执法部门抓捕绑架人员。
texts.en:
The investigation into the missing denizens of [missing_pops_planet.GetName] has revealed that they were all offered a job at a soon-to-open space casino called "Sky Castle," by sharp dressed recruiters speaking an unidentified alien language. Further inquiry has revealed that if such a casino does in fact exist, it is not within any known part of the galaxy.

As the presence of the strike force seems to be deterring the kidnappers from striking again they have been relieved to give local law enforcement a chance of luring the abductors back out.

texts.zh:
我们的科学家警告称，一个可疑的经销商正在我们的帝国内出售一种被称为寿无限的有机抗衰老霜。

他们的标语是——寿无限，使你寿命无限，这款广受欢迎的药用化妆品的原料是一种神秘的奇迹提取物，[ointment_name.GetName]精华。

虽然其有可能带来些令人不安的副作用，但是这款产品显示出了其促进细胞再生的极大潜力，研究委员会极力建议我们购买一批新产品。
texts.en:
Some of our scientists have raised the alarm on a new "all organic" anti-aging cream called Ageless, that is being sold throughout the empire by a seemingly questionable distributor.

Advertised under the slogan "Age less with Ageless", the wildly popular cosmeceutical is said to promote cell regeneration with a "unique formula" containing the mysterious miracle ingredient "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]".

Though it can cause some very disturbing side-effects the product has shown real potential of stimulating cell growth and our research council highly recommends procuring a shipment to recreate its formula.

label.zh: 改善细胞再生听起来挺有前途。
减少皱纹并不是一个全国性问题。
label.en: Wrinkle reduction is hardly a national concern.

texts.zh: 最近一种名叫寿无限的抗衰老霜疯狂地在全帝国境内传播。这种抗衰老霜已经被证实具有刺激细胞再生的功能。如果我们能确定其中起作用的成分，或许能延长其有效时间。
texts.en: The new anti-aging cream Ageless is spreading like a wild-fire throughout the empire, and has shown promise of actually stimulating cell-regeneration. If we could identify the active agent we might be able to use it to produce a more lasting effect.

texts.zh:
我们对这种抗衰老软膏的研究和深入分析充分的揭示了其神秘奇迹原料的本质，[ointment_name.GetName]精华实际上是一种从活体[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]腺体中获得的一种提取物，毫无疑问这是一种痛苦而危险的野蛮行径。

而好消息是，这让我们发现了一种能够刺激腺体的注射形式，能够显著提高我们的预期寿命，似乎再生的钥匙一直都隐藏在我们身体里面！
texts.en:
A thorough analysis of the anti-aging cream "Ageless" has revealed that the origin of the rejuvenating miracle ingredient, "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]", is quite close to home. In fact it can only be extracted from the glands of live [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], in a barbaric procedure that is undoubtedly both painful and dangerous.

In better news these finds have allowed us to create an injection that stimulates the gland, improving life-expectancy significantly. It seems that the key to regeneration was inside us all along!

label.zh: 找到那个实施这种暴行的卑鄙生物！
label.en: Find the vile creatures that did this to us!

title.en: In Pursuit of a Wrinkle-Free Existence

texts.zh: 我们必须找到这种抗衰老霜的来源。
texts.en: We must find the origin of this cream.

texts.zh:
在军队和社会学研究部门的联合努力下，寿无限抗衰老霜的供应链已经被我们锁定，供应方是一个[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]所有的科学枢纽 ，该机关曾隶属于某个政府，由艾克斯哈索尔博士及其科研团队组成。

[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]从其中获取了巨大的利润，当然，他们不太可能知道原料的来源。
texts.en:
In a coordinated effort between the military and the society research department, we have followed the distribution chain of the "Ageless" anti-aging cream back to a Science Nexus owned by the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName], where it was developed by a government-employed researcher named Dr. Xhaxxore and his team.

The [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName] has been making a huge profit off of the product and it seems unlikely that they wouldn't know the source of its key ingredient.

label.zh: 他们必须立即释放受害者并召回所有产品！
label.en: They must release the victims and withdraw the product immediately.

tooltips.en: Sends an envoy with our civilly worded request.

tooltips.zh: 对于外交事务来说，这已经太晚了。
tooltips.en: It is much too late for diplomatic exchanges.

label.zh: 我们不可能去引起一场外交事故。
label.en: We cannot risk a diplomatic incident.

texts.zh:
据称，[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发现了我们绑架并囚禁他们物种中的一些成员的证据，并称我们的目的是从这些活体中提取一种能够让细胞再生的酶。

他们要求我们立刻释放这些实验体并召回所有产品，否则两国之间的和平就无法得到保证。接受他们的要求就意味着我们的秘密实验计划将会流产。
texts.en:
We have had word from the [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who claim to have uncovered evidence of our involvement in the kidnapping and unlawful imprisonment of several of their kind, for the purpose of extracting a cell regenerating enzyme from their glands.

They demand that we release them and withdraw the product in the interest of keeping the peace between our empires. Adhering to their demands would mean the premature end to our clandestine credit-generating scheme...

label.en: We have no interest in keeping the peace...

texts.zh:
我们赢得了这场正义的战争！

尽管[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]很明显在撒谎，声称他们自己从未知道这种[ointment_name.GetName]是如何制造的，至少他们释放了我们的公民回到[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上。

这项研究的带头者艾克斯哈索尔博士已经悄悄的跑路了，但研究团队的其他成员将受到正义的审判。
texts.en:
We have fought the good fight and won!

Though the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName] claim they never knew of the sinister origins of the "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]," which is clearly a lie, at least they had the decency of returning our citizens to their home on [missing_pops_planet.GetName].

As for Dr. Xhaxxore, the head researcher and mastermind behind the scheme, he has escaped under mysterious circumstances, but the rest of his team is being brought to justice.

texts.zh: 我们收到了来自[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]的正式回信，他们坚持否认进行过抗衰老霜的开发，并劝告我们找点“更实际的方法来宣泄一下面对优越的[fountain_of_youth_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]时产生的自卑情绪，而非伪造证据来进行一些无意义的控诉。”
texts.en: We have received a formal reply from the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName], forcefully denying their involvement in the production of the "Ageless" anti-aging cream and encouraging us to find "a more constructive outlet for our apparent inferiority complex towards the superior [fountain_of_youth_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], than the fabrication of toothless accusations".

texts.zh:
我们还未收到[target_country.GetName]对于他们绑架并进行活体实验来制造抗衰老霜的相关回复。但据可靠消息称，艾克斯哈索尔已经携带剩余的精华潜逃，为他们的牟利画上了句号。

我们的目标很明确，我们要把那些仍在受苦的受害者们，连同他们的家人一同带回[missing_pops_planet.GetName]。
texts.en:
We have had no response from the [target_country.GetName] regarding their involvement in the kidnapping of our kind for the purpose of producing the anti-aging cream "Ageless". But word has it Dr. Xhaxxore has fled with most of what was left of the essence, finally putting an end to their profiteering.

Our thoughts go out today to the doctor's many victims who are still in captivity, and their families back on [missing_pops_planet.GetName].

title.zh: 艾克斯哈索尔博士逃走了！

texts.zh: [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对我们否认我们牵涉绑架一事感到不满。并且，艾克斯哈索尔博士似乎察觉到了风声，带着实验体跑了，这让我们无法生产更多的抗衰老膏。
texts.en: The [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were not pleased that we denied our involvement in the kidnapping of their kind. What's more Dr. Xhaxxore, smelling smoke, has fled taking his supply of essence with him, making it impossible to produce more Ageless cream.

texts.zh:
葛洛亦克博士和她的团队发明了一个神经库——一台能储存并使用所有上传至其驱动的大脑认知能力的有机计算机，这能极大提高我们的研究速度。不过有一个缺陷：为了有效运行，上传的大脑必须从对象身体中取出并放置在传导性液体中。对象必须和物质存在切断关系。

正如预料的那样，志愿者并没有多到要排队，目前为止只有一个——科学家[volunteer_leader.GetName]。
texts.en:
Dr. Groik and her team have invented a neural bank - an organic computer that stores and harnesses the collective cognitive power of all brains that are uploaded to its drive, greatly improving our research speed. But there's one hitch - to function properly, the uploaded brains have to be extracted from the subjects' bodies and placed within a tank of conductive fluids. Since our bodies can not survive long without a brain, subjects will have to leave their material existence behind.

As expected, volunteers have not been lining up. So far there has been only one - science leader [volunteer_leader.GetName].

tooltips.zh:
科学枢纽现在将提供额外的：
£physics£50£society£50£engineering£50
tooltips.en:
The Science Nexus will now produce an additional:
£physics£ 50 £society£ 50 £engineering£ 50

texts.zh:
葛洛亦克博士和她的团队发明了一个神经库——一台能储存并使用所有上传至其驱动的大脑认知能力的有机计算机，这能极大提高我们的研究速度。不过有一个缺陷：为了有效运行，上传的大脑必须从对象身体中取出并放置在传导性液体中。对象必须和物质存在切断关系。

正如预料的那样，志愿者并没有多到要排队，目前为止只有一个——葛洛亦克的团队里一个优秀的年轻科学研究者。但她的家人提出1000点能量币的赔偿。
texts.en:
Dr. Groik and her team have invented a neural bank - an organic computer that stores and harnesses the collective cognitive power of all brains that are uploaded to its drive, greatly improving our research speed. But there's one hitch - to function properly, the uploaded brains have to be extracted from the subjects' bodies and placed within a tank of conductive fluids. Since our bodies can not survive long without a brain, subjects will have to leave their material existence behind.

As expected, volunteers have not been lining up. So far there has been only one - a bright young researcher on Groik's team. However, she has a family to provide for and requests monetary compensation of 1000 credits for them.

texts.zh:
就在刚才科学枢纽物理部门的工作人员全体昏迷了近15分钟。当他们醒来时物理学家[abducted_leader.GetName]失踪了，[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的办公室被翻了个底朝天，[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的存储器被清空，[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的驱动也被烧焦了。

[abducted_leader.GetHerHisCap]的同事认为那是[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]保存文件用于[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]个人研究的地方。虽然[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]对自己的研究闭口不提，看起来[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的研究已经快要取得突破了。

有些工作人员提及在失去知觉前见过紫色的亮光，目前没有有关[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]去向的线索。
texts.en:
Just now the staff of the Science Nexus physics department simultaneously blacked out for almost 15 minutes. When they woke up again physics leader [abducted_leader.GetName], was missing, [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] office had been upturned, [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] storage emptied and [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] drives fried.

[abducted_leader.GetHerHisCap] colleagues believe that's where [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] kept data on a personal project [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] [abducted_leader.GetWasWere] working on. Though tight-lipped about [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] research, it seems [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] [abducted_leader.GetWasWere] nearing a breakthrough.

Several of the staff mentioned seeing a bright purple light before losing consciousness. There have been no other clues as to [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] whereabouts.

texts.zh:
这个上午的早些时候科学枢纽的工作人员发现失踪的物理学家[abducted_leader.GetName]在餐厅吃早餐，好像什么都没有发生过一样。

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap]宣称[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]刚从[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]床上爬起来，并且没有有关离开科学枢纽的回忆，但数位[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]同事声称[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]让同事感到不适，而[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]只是假装不记得。

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap]回归之后，对以前[abducted_leader.GetHerHim]不擅长的领域简直了如指掌。[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]目前正在等待指派。
texts.en:
Early this morning the Science Nexus staff discovered missing physics leader [abducted_leader.GetName] in the canteen, having breakfast, as if nothing happened.

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap] claim[abducted_leader.GetSXX] [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] awoke in [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] bed just moments previously and has no recollection of ever leaving the Science Nexus. But several of [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] colleagues have voiced concerns that [abducted_leader.GetSheHe][abducted_leader.GetSRe] making the staff uncomfortable and that [abducted_leader.GetSheHe][abducted_leader.GetSRe] only pretending not to remember.

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap] [abducted_leader.GetHasHave] also returned with an uncanny understanding of subjects previously unknown to [abducted_leader.GetHerHim]. [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] [abducted_leader.GetIsAre] currently awaiting assignment.

texts.zh:
葛洛亦克博士和她的团队发明了一个神经库——一台能储存并使用所有上传至其驱动的大脑认知能力的有机计算机，这能极大提高我们的研究速度。不过有一个缺陷：为了有效运行，上传的大脑必须从对象身体中取出并放置在传导性液体中。对象必须和物质存在切断关系。

正如预料的那样，志愿者并没有多到要排队，目前为止只有一个——科学家[volunteer_leader.GetName]。
texts.en:
Dr. Groik and her team have invented a neural bank - an organic computer that stores and harnesses the collective cognitive power of all brains that are uploaded to its drive, greatly improving our research speed. But there's one hitch - to function properly, the uploaded brains have to be extracted from the subjects' bodies and placed within a tank of conductive fluids. Since our bodies can not survive long without a brain, subjects will have to leave their material existence behind.

As expected, volunteers have not been lining up. So far there has been only one - science leader [volunteer_leader.GetName].
